title: Thinking on Courage vs Daring
summary: Kahran and Divya pull apart the difference between courage and daring — courage as paying a personal cost for something hard, daring as paying a social cost for breaking what's expected. They detour through the bystander effect and Kitty Genovese, D&D alignments and rogue characters in Shadow and Bone, and what they'd actually want to build into the culture of their company.
topics: asking for the doctor on the plane
